state.task: Audit Can syntax/ABI at 8312d85. Zero users; user explicitly rejects compatibility as a design constraint. This is advice, not implementation or safety certification. Optimize agent-readable, checkable, small coherent semantics. Keep nominal authority, exact math, explicit effects/errors, honest proof/witness evidence.
observed: Records flatten success while other types wrap .value; B11 added typed Ok<T> and typed binders preserving both old cases.
13 std files: 401 fn, 108 record declarations (65 one-field; not all disposable), 486 match-call sites.
call f(...) vs invoke cb with x; invocation resolves Fn parameters only; Fn unary/data-only captures and heads.
String-parsed types, special nested-generic restrictions, no first-class outcomes or generic error algebra.
Cross-file pure Can calls require scripts, same-file execute; linked-pure mode exists.
Global __ names, duplicate provides lists, no visibility, module emits unchecked; duplicate record identities silently first-win in a repro.
TS direct mutable arrays/Uint8Array and brands->string; host trust assumed, no generated ownership or validation boundary.
Exact int bigint, dec canonical string; dec source d"0.5", ordinary strings raw with e prefix for escapes.
Confirmed pinned callback expectation target can change with body and yield no acceptance warning because canonSmall fnref is unknown-kind(fnref).
B05 has competing design-only Promise vs private-machine proposals; resources not implemented.
state.boundaries: Distinguish source semantics, private execution ABI, public host ABI, and wire schemas. Public ABI safety need not dictate private layout. Migration cost is engineering work, not an external user-compatibility veto.

first.instructions: What should lead the redesign sequence?

criteria.evidence_then_core: Fix confirmed identity/evidence defects, define type/core IR and ABI contracts, then migrate uniform outcomes/calls in green slices.
criteria.cosmetic_first: Rename/reformat surface syntax before compiler/core contracts.
criteria.async_first: Implement async scheduler before unifying existing value/call rules.
criteria.one_big_rewrite: Replace every source and backend subsystem in one change.

success.instructions: Choose canonical success semantics without compatibility obligations.

criteria.uniform_one_value: Ok(value), binder is T for every return type; one public success envelope independent of record shape.
criteria.typed_dual: Keep B11 typed and untyped forms and the flattened-record ABI permanently.
criteria.contextual_flat: Infer record field/splat behavior contextually while preserving flattened records.
criteria.raw_total: Use raw values for error-free functions and outcomes only for fallible functions.

calls.instructions: Choose source application spelling while preserving explicit error/effect analysis.

criteria.unified_call: One explicit call f(args) syntax for named functions and callable expressions, plus local bindings and irrefutable Ok patterns for error-free calls.
criteria.bare_application: Use f(args) for all function application, relying on typing rather than a call keyword.
criteria.retain_split: Keep match call for named functions and match invoke name with arg for callbacks.
criteria.implicit_propagation: Make ordinary application implicitly return early on errors.

modules.instructions: Choose module and symbol identity model.

criteria.scoped_imports: Real module namespaces, local short names, explicit public exports/imports, exact artifact identities in a manifest; case identity includes parent type.
criteria.flat_globals: Keep global domain__ names and exhaustive provides lists.
criteria.unscoped_search: Resolve names by searching reachable files without explicit imports.

pure_tests.instructions: Choose normal test semantics for checked pure source across module boundaries.

criteria.execute_pure: Execute checked pure Can bodies independent of file location; explicit mocks only for deliberate boundary tests; observations remain scripted.
criteria.file_driven: Keep cross-file Can scripted and same-file Can executed.
criteria.mock_everything: Script local and foreign pure calls alike.

host.instructions: Choose public JS/TS host value boundary policy.

criteria.owned_validated: Generated versioned entry adapters with validation, explicit ownership/snapshots, readonly/opaque TS facades; internal checked code may optimize.
criteria.trusted_direct: Only document trusted mutable JS inputs and erasure; expose generated internal functions directly.
criteria.freeze_only: Freeze every JS object/typed array and rely on TS types rather than validation.

error_core.instructions: Choose the long-term error abstraction to support reusable generic combinators without erasing failures.

criteria.finite_error_rows: Finite declared error-set algebra and first-class completed Outcome<T,E>; explicitly define consumption/transfer and catalogue accounting before shipping.
criteria.untyped_exception: Replace declared errors with host exceptions.
criteria.fixed_only: Keep only concrete per-function error lists forever.
criteria.open_any_error: Use a universal error type/catch-all for generic combinators.

async_boundary.instructions: What should this audit recommend for async ABI?

criteria.resolve_b05: Preserve structured ownership obligations, explicitly resolve the competing B05 backend proposals before choosing a private machine/completion ABI; keep public adapter contract distinct.
criteria.promise_everywhere_now: Immediately promise a universal public Promise ABI as the final design.
criteria.sync_forever: Protect the current synchronous public output permanently because existing goldens use it.
